message: 仲魔

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You handled yourself pretty well with Aze earlier today.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what the previous Demon Kings used to do?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What they used to do about what?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, when you say 'Demon Lord,' normally they're supposed to lead the demons, rule or invade the Human World, fight angels, stuff like that, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Truth be told, a few of the past Demon Kings actually tried to conquer the Three Realms and fought angels and demons alike.」

name: Synn
message: 「What happened to those Demon Kings?」

name: Paqy
message: 「None of 'em ever pulled off world conquest.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though they were super strong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Their bodies are still human at the base, so they age, and they're only absurdly strong during Re-Crea anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So even if they're strong, they aren't strong all the time. That's a relief.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh? Why's that? I'm tellin' you they couldn't conquer the world.」

name: Synn
message: 「I always wondered why Dad had me succeed him as Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have the slightest desire to be a typical Demon Lord, and Dad must've known that too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「As if that softie would ever throw his own son into a world of blood and violence, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Paqy
message: 「He'd go out of his way to help anyone, whether they were demon, human, or angel. Had me on edge wondering when he'd get conned.」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured as much.」

name: Paqy
message: 「He actually got conned plenty of times, too. Who knows what would've happened without yours truly backing him up.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if the scale of Re-Crea back then was smaller than this time, he saved the world without hurting friend or foe right to the very end--that was pretty damn admirable.」
Dad really was amazing after all.

name: Sally
message: 「Good evening--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, sorry, you're supposed to knock before entering a room, right.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Knocking after you've already entered the room--and from the inside, no less--is completely pointless, y'know.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true. Before, she didn't even realize it.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, that's right! I'm sure in 100 years, I'll only forget to knock every once in a while!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That progress is way too slow.」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, did you already eat dinner?」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't eaten yet today.」

name: Sally
message: 「Lucky us! Believe it or not, today Boss and I are gonna treat you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Prez. Brought. Care package.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. Where'd you get so many of these?」
The bag Eauderourke carried on his back was packed full of beef bowls.
One, two, three--tons of them!

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Me, work. Get, reward.」
With Eauderourke in it, the room looked super cramped.
Actually, how did he even fit in here... Maybe Eauderourke is surprisingly flexible.

name: Sally
message: 「I've been working hard too, y'know! Ahem.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Eat, beef bowl. Prez, thanks. Repay, favor.」

name: Sally
message: 「So yeah! Eat up, Prez.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Yup, yup. Don't, hold back.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Well then, I won't hold back. Thanks for the meal!」
It was a really delicious beef bowl.
It had cooled down a bit, but it tasted better than any beef bowl I'd ever eaten.

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Thanks, not enough.」

name: Sally
message: 「Our gratitude is as huge as the moon!」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Prez, friend. Help, friends.」

name: Synn
message: 「You two...」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are we gonna do when Synn-sama is fighting Demons or something?」

name: Sally
message: 「That doesn't even matter! I owe you for the beef bowl!」
It was a truly happy night.
Sally joined the party!
Eauderourke joined the party!
